title: Davis uses DIA deputization to get access to the crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: using my security clearances my need to know my access including my letter that I'm deputized by Jim Lowsky as a representative of the of the Defense Intelligence Agency. I used all that leverage and authority to get into the crash retrieval program. I couldn't get access to CCraft bodies or talk to the people, but I was able to get in to the people who handled all of that at a programmatic level and got confirmation that all of that was real, that all of it happened.

plain: A Pentagon scientist named Eric W. Davis says he got inside a secret program that recovers crashed craft. He used his security clearances and a letter from a Defense Intelligence Agency official named Jim Lacatski that made him an official representative of that agency, which is the US military's main intelligence service. Davis says he never saw any craft or bodies, but he reached the people who ran the program at the management level, and they told him "all of that was real, that all of it happened," which if true would mean the government holds non-human craft.
